description: Defines the BinaryValue class for representing DynamoDB binary values within the AWS SDK for PHP, including serialization and string conversion methods.

classes.name: BinaryValue
classes.description: Represents a DynamoDB binary (B) value with JSON serialization and string conversion capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BinaryValue with a string or stream-compatible value, converting streams to strings.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the binary value for JSON serialization.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the binary value as a string.
